escena: SCENE (documentary, on location at a client's family bakery before opening): an Efeonce strategist in the navy Efeonce polo with the Efeonce lanyard, badge card turned away and unreadable, sits on a flour sack across from the baker and listens, caught at the exact moment she leans in and writes a single word in her notebook while he explains with floury hands; nobody looks at the lens. A hard warm light from the open oven mouth behind them, the brightest thing in the frame and warms their faces; cool dawn light from the shop window rims them from the side. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook in her hands carries the only blue. White tiled wall above them, plain and evenly shadowed. 35mm f/2. No readable signs or labels.

lecho.objeto: the floury wooden counter edge right at the lens, dissolved into blur and outside the oven light

texto.muro: the plain, evenly shadowed white tiled wall high above them
